tagline: A Theatrical VTT Engine tailored for Story-Driven Board Games.
designBaseline: 美式/叙事驱动桌游的戏剧化 VTT 引擎：以 Node-Graph 表达地图与位置，以通用 Entity 表达配件与角色，以 JSON 规则树驱动事件流和 CCFOLIA 风格 Cut-in 自动演出。
validationScenario: Local testing only: E2E validation via ignored LOTR Tabletop Simulator fixture.

features.title: 环境配置与 Vercel 部署
features.description: 创建 React + Vite + TypeScript + Zustand + PixiJS + Vitest 项目骨架，补齐 package.json、lockfile、src/、tests/ 和稳定 npm scripts。配置 Vercel 静态站点部署，确保 main 分支可自动发布生产站点，并将 Vercel 部署 URL 写入 evidence。
features.verification: bash ./init.sh && npm run build；Vercel production deployment 通过后记录部署 URL

evidence.pixijsSkills: skills-lock.json records 26 PixiJS skills installed from pixijs/pixijs-skills under .agents/skills.
evidence.notes: Vercel production deployment is READY. Vite build reports a large PixiJS chunk warning, acceptable for F-00 and to revisit during feature-level code splitting.

features.title: 核心图谱 Board
features.description: 引擎层支持导入任意图片作为底图。实现点对点 Node-Graph 架构，提供创建/删除 Location 和连线的 API 与 UI，剔除任何 Grid 相关代码。

evidence.notes: F-01 implements normalized Node-Graph Board state, arbitrary uploaded image background references, Location and Edge create/update/delete APIs, a neutral Maker UI, PixiJS/@pixi/react canvas interactions, Select as the default editing mode, empty-map hand cursor and drag panning, mouse-wheel map zoom in drag mode, mouse-wheel scaling for selected placed template copies, full board view reset for zoom and pan, deletable image assets, configurable draggable piece templates, editable/deletable placed template copies, copy-limit guarded template placements, scroll-contained sidebars, map zoom controls, collapsible left Creation toolbar, collapsible right Board inspector, and central board expansion when sidebars are hidden. Template placements remain F-01 Maker placeholders; F-02 will map templates to real Entity instances. No grid, pathfinding, tactical distance, or game-specific branches were introduced.

features.title: 通用 Entity 系统
features.description: 实现通用 Entity 状态模型 `{ id, type, state: Record<string, any> }`。允许 GM 定义任意属性键值对，例如 hp、faction、stealth。提供在 Node 间绑定/解绑 Entity 的逻辑。

coverage: src/engine/entity.ts implements generic EntityState, Entity { id, type, state, locationId? }, create/update/remove, Location bind/unbind, and clearLocationBindings for removed Locations.
RESOURCE_CATEGORY_DEFINITIONS defines BOARD, PAWN, TOKEN, TILE, CARD, OTHER with layer, template, binding, and pathing metadata.
src/state/boardStore.ts maps categorized uploaded image assets to entity templates and creates/removes runtime Entities for placed template copies.
src/ui/App.tsx exposes category selection for uploaded assets and changes the sidebar from Piece Templates to Entity Templates.
src/ui/BoardCanvas.tsx layers TILE placements below graph nodes and requires PAWN/TOKEN drops to bind to a nearby Location.
tests/engine/entity.test.ts covers arbitrary state, Location binding/unbinding, removed Location binding cleanup, missing Location rejection, and six resource category semantics.
tests/state/boardStore.test.ts covers categorized asset -> template -> placement -> Entity creation and deletion.
evidence.notes: Browser plugin validation was attempted but the Node REPL browser bridge failed with a Windows sandbox spawn setup error in this environment. Dev server startup was also blocked across shell turns because background processes are cleaned up; tests and production build were used as the repeatable evidence for this pass. No grid/pathfinding/game-specific branches were introduced.

features.title: 图谱移动校验
features.description: 实现通用的图谱移动校验算法。暴露 API 供外部调用，判断 Entity 能否合法移动到目标 Node，第一版仅基于连线连通性。

features.title: 全局追踪器与视觉映射
features.description: 实现 Global Trackers 与视觉滤镜映射表。引擎允许配置任意全局变量，如 Time、Threat、Sanity，并允许通过映射字典将数值区间绑定到 PixiJS 滤镜组合。

features.title: JSON 规则触发器引擎
features.description: 实现泛用事件监听器。允许以 JSON 注入规则树，例如 `{ trigger: "ENTITY_MOVE", conditions: [{ attr: "faction", operator: "!==" }], actions: ["DISPATCH_CUT_IN"] }`。引擎负责解析并在条件命中时发射事件流。

features.title: Cut-in 演出渲染层
features.description: 实现底层 Cut-in 渲染总线。当接收到 `DISPATCH_CUT_IN` 指令时，依据 payload 在前端渲染遮罩、图片滑入动画和打字机文本。

features.title: .lorecanvas 剧本包序列化
features.description: 提供整个引擎 state 的深度序列化与反序列化 API，覆盖图谱、实体、追踪器映射、触发器 JSON 和演出资源引用，产出 `.lorecanvas` 剧本包。

features.title: LOTR 本地端到端验收
features.description: 不污染核心引擎，编写特定 E2E 测试脚本。通过调用 F-01 至 F-07 的引擎 API 并加载被 `.gitignore` 排除的 LOTR 专属 fixture，走通一次“戒灵拦截 -> 触发滤镜变深与演出”的测试闭环。
